[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra III.35 (Vibhūtipāda) — parārthatvāt svārthasaṃyamāt puruṣajñānam | Pages 633-639]

naṃ kiṃ buddhisattvasya bhavati, kiṃ vā
puruṣasya bhavati ? Ādye buddher api cetanatvāpattiḥ, svoktaparādṛśyatvānupapattiś ca ; tathā te
taṃ na paśyanti sa paśyate tān ity ādivākyaśatavirodhaś ca ; antye svajñeyatvena karmakartṛvirodhaḥ,
tadaiva svajñāprasaṅgaś ca, puruṣasyāpariṇāmicinmātratvād iti tām imām āśaṅkāṃ pariharati-- na
ca puruṣasyeti / Puruṣākārapratyayena buddhisattvadharmeṇa puruṣo na dṛśyate na bhāsyete, tasya
jaḍatvād ; api tu puruṣa eva taṃ pratyayaṃ svasvarūpākāraṃ paśyati buddhyārūḍham ātmānaṃ
paśyatīty arthaḥ / Svasmin pratibimbitam iti śeṣaḥ /
- On a dit qu'il y a puruṣaj~āna 'expérience cognitive du puruṣa'. Cette connaissance du puruṣa
